College

21 June 2016

Cost

Living on a college campus exposes me daily to people who are dealing with the cost of college. I have seen or heard of several protests due to the recent tuition hikes after a five-year tuition freeze. Currently, the tuition at UCSC comes to $13,515 for undergraduates and $14,049 for graduates. Is the cost worth it?

According to the Bureau of Labor Statistics, in 2014 the median income difference between high school graduates and college graduates with an undergraduate degree was $433 per week.
